name: vLLM Team
description: High-signal vLLM releases verified against official vLLM project release notes, docs, and GitHub releases.
headline: Verified vLLM releases across {days} days.
subtitle: October 2025 — May 2026. Official vLLM releases and docs.
footnote: Cross-checked on May 9, 2026 against official vLLM GitHub releases, the vLLM blog, and the docs.vllm.ai changelog.

releases.title: v0.4.1 patch release
releases.description: vLLM v0.4.1 shipped CUDA graph stability fixes, RoPE scaling tweaks, and a fix for AWQ kernel correctness on Hopper.

releases.title: v0.4.2 released
releases.description: vLLM v0.4.2 introduced scheduler improvements and higher throughput defaults for common decoder-only models, plus an experimental --enable-chunked-prefill default.

releases.title: vLLM Office Hours #14: Meet the maintainers
releases.description: vLLM hosted Office Hours #14, a community livestream covering the v0.5 roadmap, multimodal serving updates, and Q&A with the core maintainer team.

releases.title: v0.5.0 major release
releases.description: vLLM v0.5.0 shipped a major runtime update with expanded model compatibility, upgraded serving ergonomics, and a refactored attention backend layer that ships FlashAttention 3 by default on H100/H200.

releases.title: v0.5.1 patch release
releases.description: vLLM v0.5.1 included follow-up fixes after the v0.5.0 cut: chunked prefill memory regression, structured-output guided JSON edge cases, and Qwen2-VL position embedding.

releases.title: OpenAI-compatible tools API improvements
releases.description: vLLM improved tool-calling compatibility in its OpenAI-compatible server, including stricter schema handling, streaming fixes, and a new --tool-call-parser flag with Llama, Hermes, and Mistral parsers.

releases.title: v0.6.0 released
releases.description: vLLM v0.6.0 added broader multimodal inference support and improved memory management for long-context serving, plus a new --speculative-config interface for speculative decoding.

releases.title: Speculative decoding GA
releases.description: vLLM promoted speculative decoding to general availability with EAGLE-2, MTP, and ngram drafters, including a documented --speculative-config recipe per model family.

releases.title: v0.6.1 release
releases.description: vLLM v0.6.1 shipped Phi-4 multimodal support, expanded LoRA serving, and a chunked prefill correctness fix that improves throughput on long-context Llama 3 deployments.

releases.title: Disaggregated prefill enters beta
releases.description: vLLM published beta support for disaggregated prefill/decode serving architectures to optimize latency under mixed loads, with a Kubernetes operator reference for production rollouts.

releases.title: Prometheus metrics v2
releases.description: vLLM shipped Prometheus metrics v2 with per-request KV cache usage, per-model concurrency gauges, and Grafana dashboards under examples/observability/.

releases.title: v0.6.2 patch release
releases.description: vLLM v0.6.2 shipped stability fixes for tensor parallel deployments, improved observability metrics exports, and a Hopper kernel fix for FP8 attention with grouped-query attention models.

releases.title: TensorRT-LLM bridge experimental
releases.description: vLLM landed an experimental TensorRT-LLM bridge for routing prefill or decode workloads through TRT-LLM kernels on Blackwell, exposed behind --executor=trtllm.

releases.title: ROCm 6.4 + AMD MI300X production guide
releases.description: vLLM published a production-ready ROCm 6.4 + AMD MI300X deployment guide with quark W4A8 GPT-OSS recipes, validated DeepSeek and Llama 3 numbers, and CI coverage on AMD CI runners.

releases.title: v0.7.0-rc1 published
releases.description: vLLM released v0.7.0-rc1 with upgraded plugin hooks and early distributed serving enhancements for large clusters, plus a Ray-based scheduler that reuses prefill outputs across nodes.

releases.title: Disk-tier prefix caching
releases.description: vLLM added a disk-backed L2 prefix cache that survives restarts and shares across worker pods through CSI-mounted NVMe, complementing the existing in-GPU and CPU prefix caches.

releases.title: Llama Stack 1.0 vLLM provider GA
releases.description: vLLM and Meta promoted the Llama Stack vLLM provider to GA in Llama Stack 1.0, with documented inference, agent, eval, and safety endpoints validated against Llama 3.x and Llama 4 checkpoints.

releases.title: v0.7.0 stable release
releases.description: vLLM v0.7.0 reached stable with improved production autoscaling signals, scheduler tuning, and expanded backend support, plus a documented upgrade path from v0.6.x deployments.

releases.title: v0.20.0 released
releases.description: vLLM v0.20.0 shipped DeepSeek V4 support, CUDA 13.0 default wheels, PyTorch 2.11, Python 3.14 support, FlashAttention 4 as the default MLA prefill backend, and TurboQuant 2-bit KV cache.

releases.title: v0.7.1 released
releases.description: vLLM v0.7.1 shipped post-0.7 stability fixes, improved memory fragmentation handling, and scheduler bug fixes for production clusters.

releases.title: v0.20.1 patch release
releases.description: vLLM v0.20.1 focused on DeepSeek V4 stabilization and performance improvements, plus bug fixes for CUDA graph capture, memory-pool behavior, structured-output reasoning parser kwargs, and ROCm Quark W4A8 GPT-OSS arguments.

releases.title: MLPerf Inference v4.2 reference numbers published
releases.description: vLLM published reference MLPerf Inference v4.2 numbers for DeepSeek V4-Pro, Llama 4 70B Instruct, and Mistral Medium 3.5 across H100, H200, B200, and MI300X, with reproducer scripts under benchmarks/mlperf.

releases.title: v0.20.2 patch release
releases.description: vLLM v0.20.2 shipped fixes for the new disk prefix cache eviction policy, a regression in tool-call streaming with Mistral parsers, and improved error messages for unsupported quantization combinations.
